item.title: SA Health issues Measles alert after infant sparks health concerns at local hospital
item.description: SA Health warns of potential measles exposure after an infant, infected overseas, visited several public spaces in South Australia.

item.title: SES warns of storms, flash flooding and isolation risks across northern South Australia as residents urged to prepare now
item.description: The SES has issued a community readiness alert for northern South Australia as heavy rain, thunderstorms and flash flooding risk impact outback communities this weekend.
